method: Static AST/text inventory, reviewed effect summaries; test references are not measured coverage.

scripts.inputs: Presence of user MCP config paths.
scripts.outputs: Printed memory integration guidance.
scripts.effects: Reads config-file existence only; no installation/network. Output depends on user config; not characterized.

scripts.inputs: Container socket/environment and HTTP byte stream.
scripts.outputs: Forwarded proxy stream.
scripts.effects: Starts a local socket and forwards to mounted Unix socket; exercised by container E2E, not a public argparse CLI.

scripts.inputs: Package metadata.
scripts.outputs: Version/module identity.
scripts.effects: No direct effects.

scripts.inputs: Member/invite/session tokens, request limits.
scripts.outputs: Auth records, cookies and checks.
scripts.effects: Random secrets, expiry/time and database auth updates; no outward messages.

scripts.inputs: Parsed Relay commands/config/instance.
scripts.outputs: CLI diagnostics and state.
scripts.effects: Init/config/database writes, invites, lock, HTTP service, reconciliation, container execution via service.
parser_declarations: p.add_argument('--adopt-chain-key', action='store_true', help=f'start keying an existing unkeyed log with {CHAIN_KEY_ENV}')
p.add_argument('--apply', action='store_true', help='make the changes; requires `serve` to be stopped')
p.add_argument('--events', type=Path, required=True, help='NEXUS events JSONL (created if missing)')
p.add_argument('--instance', type=Path, required=True, help='NEXUS instance JSON with mandate.scope local-relay')
p.add_argument('--public-origin', help='https origin of your TLS tunnel, e.g. https://box.tailnet.ts.net')
sub.add_parser('anchor', help='print the current log head to record outside this machine')
sub.add_parser('init', help='create the data directory, config and owner sign-in link')
sub.add_parser('invite', help='print a new single-use sign-in link for an existing member')
sub.add_parser('reconcile', help='repair runs interrupted between NEXUS and the room database (dry run by default)')
sub.add_parser('verify', help='check the log chain and replay the NEXUS events')

scripts.inputs: Local config, instance and runtime settings.
scripts.outputs: Validated configuration / paths.
scripts.effects: Reads and initializes local config/state; no model call.

scripts.inputs: Run output, workspace paths and byte budget.
scripts.outputs: Bounded manifests and SHA-256 pins.
scripts.effects: Local bounded file reads; verifies output/workspace hashes.

scripts.inputs: Message content, media and policy bounds.
scripts.outputs: Conservative token/input bounds.
scripts.effects: Pure analysis of supplied data; no URL fetching.

scripts.inputs: Instance/events and admission requests.
scripts.outputs: Replay/admission and projected events.
scripts.effects: Reads engine/instance/events, appends admitted events.

scripts.inputs: Provider request JSON/headers.
scripts.outputs: Allowlisted request or policy rejection.
scripts.effects: No transport; anti-egress rules reject server tools, mcp_servers and URL sources.

scripts.inputs: Local socket, allowed provider requests and meter.
scripts.outputs: Metered/clamped provider responses.
scripts.effects: Binds Unix socket, synchronized budget accounting; forwards permitted provider calls.

scripts.inputs: Store state, NEXUS contract and incomplete runs.
scripts.outputs: Repair plan / applied projection.
scripts.effects: Planning reads; apply repairs local state/events, without retrying uncertain effects.

scripts.inputs: Admitted instruction, workspace, runtime image.
scripts.outputs: Container command / bounded result.
scripts.effects: Invokes docker/podman with isolation, streams output; no runtime available here.

scripts.inputs: Authenticated HTTP requests and Relay service.
scripts.outputs: Room API/static responses.
scripts.effects: Binds HTTP socket; writes through service after auth and CSRF checks.

scripts.inputs: Authorized room/task actions, store, contract and runner.
scripts.outputs: Run/review receipts and evidence.
scripts.effects: Coordinates database writes, NEXUS events, workspaces, proxy and container invocation.

scripts.inputs: SQLite path, entries and optional chain key.
scripts.outputs: Durable rows, log head/hash verification.
scripts.effects: Transactional SQLite writes and append-only hash/HMAC log; wall-clock timestamps.

scripts.inputs: Synthetic test fixtures / configured property count; see source.
scripts.outputs: Test assertions, diagnostics and process status.
scripts.effects: Harness may create/delete temporary fixtures, invoke CLIs or bind sockets; not an operational record.

scripts.outputs: Test assertions, diagnostics and process status.
scripts.effects: Harness may create/delete temporary fixtures, invoke CLIs or bind sockets; not an operational record.

scripts.outputs: Test assertions, diagnostics and process status.
scripts.effects: Harness may create/delete temporary fixtures, invoke CLIs or bind sockets; not an operational record.

scripts.inputs: Agent slug, observed capability and scope-policy JSON.
scripts.outputs: Capability report or scoped profile text.
scripts.effects: render writes --output when supplied.

scripts.inputs: Scenario, repeats, tool and source fixture.
scripts.outputs: Measured benchmark summaries / optional JSON.
scripts.effects: Copies sources into temporary directories; runs conversions; timing is intentionally variable.
parser_declarations: parser.add_argument('--changed-agent', type=Path, default=DEFAULT_AGENT, help='source agent perturbed in the isolated one-agent-change scenario')
parser.add_argument('--jobs', type=int, default=0, help='parallel worker count; 0 uses convert.sh default')
parser.add_argument('--json', type=Path, help='write machine-readable results to this path')
parser.add_argument('--repeat', type=int, default=1, help='number of runs per scenario')
parser.add_argument('--scenario', action='append', choices=SCENARIOS, help='scenario to run; repeat the flag to select several (default: all)')
parser.add_argument('--verbose', action='store_true', help='show converter output while benchmarking')

scripts.inputs: Registries and agent frontmatter.
scripts.outputs: CATALOG.md and optional catalog JSON; --check prints status.
scripts.effects: Default writes CATALOG.md; --json writes the specified destination.
parser_declarations: ap.add_argument('--check', action='store_true', help='fail if CATALOG.md is out of date')
ap.add_argument('--json', metavar='OUT', help='also write a machine-readable catalog to OUT')

scripts.inputs: Repo root, catalog, registries and profiles.
scripts.outputs: Generated Hermes plugin and data.
scripts.effects: Writes --out (default integrations/hermes).
parser_declarations: parser.add_argument('--out', type=Path, default=None, help='Output directory, default integrations/hermes')

scripts.inputs: Candidate agent paths and full roster.
scripts.outputs: Similarity diagnostics.
scripts.effects: Read-only; no-args mode compares the full roster.

scripts.inputs: Agent frontmatter and privilege registry.
scripts.outputs: Validation result or inventory.
scripts.effects: Read-only.

scripts.inputs: Pair registry, agents and runbooks.
scripts.outputs: Validation result.
scripts.effects: Read-only.

scripts.inputs: Tracked paths, divisions registry and lint workflow.
scripts.outputs: Validation result.
scripts.effects: Read-only; git ls-files is part of its directory discovery.

scripts.inputs: Synthetic test fixtures / configured property count; see source.
scripts.outputs: Test assertions, diagnostics and process status.
scripts.effects: Harness may create/delete temporary fixtures, invoke CLIs or bind sockets; not an operational record.

scripts.inputs: Synthetic test fixtures / configured property count; see source.
scripts.outputs: Test assertions, diagnostics and process status.
scripts.effects: Harness may create/delete temporary fixtures, invoke CLIs or bind sockets; not an operational record.

scripts.inputs: Generated plugin builder and synthetic profiles.
scripts.outputs: Validation result.
scripts.effects: Builds and loads a temporary plugin; no live Hermes host.

scripts.inputs: HTP machine-readable artifacts.
scripts.outputs: Structural validation result.
scripts.effects: Read-only; no chain access.

scripts.inputs: Runbook registry, doctrine references and agent files.
scripts.outputs: Contract/reference validation result.
scripts.effects: Read-only; structural validity does not establish closure adequacy.

scripts.inputs: Agent frontmatter / engagement registry.
scripts.outputs: Validation result or inventory.
scripts.effects: Read-only; strict YAML/JSON key loaders.

scripts.inputs: contracts.json and handoff/finding templates.
scripts.outputs: Vocabulary alignment result.
scripts.effects: Read-only.

scripts.inputs: Tools registry, installer and converter implementation.
scripts.outputs: Validation result and canonical order.
scripts.effects: Read-only.

scripts.inputs: Agent files, registries, --tool, --out.
scripts.outputs: Converted tool files and diagnostics.
scripts.effects: Rebuilds output directories, removes stale generated files; use isolated output.

scripts.inputs: Same CLI as converter, canonical integration state.
scripts.outputs: Generated adapters and state diagnostics.
scripts.effects: Delegates to engine/state; default writes integrations/.

scripts.inputs: Case definitions, trial rows and optional blind judgments.
scripts.outputs: Descriptive paired evaluation JSON.
scripts.effects: Read-only; supplied measurements are not authenticated.
parser_declarations: ap.add_argument('--require-paired', action='store_true', help='require at least one fully judged triple, no incomplete pairs and no unjudged submissions')

scripts.inputs: Host acceptance records and evidence.
scripts.outputs: Validation / model observation JSON.
scripts.effects: Read-only; does not run a host.
parser_declarations: ap.add_argument('--require', choices=['accepted', 'no-unenforced-boundary'], help='exit non-zero unless every record reaches this bar')

scripts.inputs: Recorded stream events and return code.
scripts.outputs: Conservative evidence assessment values.
scripts.effects: Library only; no CLI or host invocation.

scripts.inputs: -TargetDirs and translation map.
scripts.outputs: Localized profile files and counts.
scripts.effects: Overwrites selected installed Markdown. PowerShell unavailable; not executed.

scripts.inputs: Pinned source ref, registry and root.
scripts.outputs: Imported profiles and source registry.
scripts.effects: Fetches remote raw files even for dry-run; writes imports/registry and removes obsolete imports unless dry-run. Help/errors only.
parser_declarations: ap.add_argument('--workers', type=int, default=DEFAULT_WORKERS, help=f'parallel raw-file fetches (default: {DEFAULT_WORKERS}; use 1 for sequential)')

scripts.inputs: Tool detection, selections, install mode and generated adapters.
scripts.outputs: Installed profiles, router/plugin registration, diagnostics.
scripts.effects: Writes tool/user config and destinations; replacement/uninstall may remove owned files; only help/error captured here.

scripts.inputs: Mode, tool, source hashes and adapter state.
scripts.outputs: Freshness/check explanations and generated files.
scripts.effects: check/explain read; record/sync write granular state/adapters and may remove stale generated files.
parser_declarations: parser.add_argument('--force', action='store_true', help='force sync to perform a clean full rebuild')

scripts.inputs: Sourced shell helper arguments and environment.
scripts.outputs: Metadata / TUI helpers for callers.
scripts.effects: Library; terminal manipulation is possible in TUI helpers; no standalone CLI.

scripts.inputs: Agent Markdown paths or complete division roster.
scripts.outputs: Frontmatter/section diagnostics.
scripts.effects: Read-only; noargs validates all agents.

scripts.inputs: Newline paths on stdin and division registry.
scripts.outputs: Canonical agent paths on stdout.
scripts.effects: Read-only.

scripts.inputs: Normalized snapshot JSON, --at and thresholds.
scripts.outputs: HOLD packets with input/payload hashes.
scripts.effects: Read-only, offline; no replay events, signing, model calls or payload echo.
parser_declarations: parser.add_argument('--at', required=True, help='explicit ISO timestamp with timezone')

scripts.inputs: Scoped execution packets / observe options.
scripts.outputs: Observation / execution records.
scripts.effects: observe and execution invoke the Claude host, may spend and write records; help/errors only.
parser_declarations: sub.add_parser('observe', help='make one live host call and emit a model observation')

scripts.inputs: Trial artifacts, cases, salt and seed.
scripts.outputs: Blinded packet or deterministic submission ID.
scripts.effects: seal writes a new review directory; submission-id is read-only.
parser_declarations: ap.add_argument('--cases', help='case material and expected behavior for the reviewer')

scripts.inputs: Instance, events, explicit --at.
scripts.outputs: Owner brief JSON or Markdown.
scripts.effects: Read-only; no owner decisions or acceptance.
parser_declarations: ap.add_argument('--at', required=True, help='ISO time the brief is computed for (expiry checks)')

scripts.inputs: External held-out root, trials/judgments and policies.
scripts.outputs: Campaign status, planned work or throughput comparison.
scripts.effects: Read-only; reads evaluator-controlled packs only for an authorized evaluation, not in these captures.

scripts.inputs: Pack directory / root and author/freeze metadata.
scripts.outputs: Validation, frozen hash, listing or scaffold.
scripts.effects: new/freeze write pack files; validate/verify/list read.

scripts.inputs: Git base/head, protected rules and external held-out evaluations.
scripts.outputs: PROPOSE/REJECT plus path/metric reasons.
scripts.effects: Git reads and evaluation reads; no writes, model calls, PR creation or merge.
parser_declarations: p.add_argument('--improver', action='append', required=True, help='author label of the proposal (repeatable); held-out packs it wrote are refused')

scripts.inputs: NEXUS schema v1 JSON, optional events/checkpoint, --at.
scripts.outputs: Validation, plan or replay JSON.
scripts.effects: Offline; --output writes atomically. Default json.loads accepts duplicate keys.

scripts.inputs: Instance JSON and optional --strict.
scripts.outputs: Shape and warnings JSON.
scripts.effects: Read-only; strict changes exit status for warnings.
parser_declarations: ap.add_argument('--strict', action='store_true', help='exit 1 on warnings too')

scripts.inputs: Agent, evidence, scope limit and executor.
scripts.outputs: Bounded candidate, patch, attempts and proposal JSON.
scripts.effects: Default claude executor invokes host and spends; fake still writes artifacts. Help/errors only.

scripts.inputs: Factors, admissibility, options and scenarios JSON.
scripts.outputs: Dominance/frontier comparison, never weighted score.
scripts.effects: Read-only; no human decision is executed.

scripts.inputs: Instance, authority assertions, observations and events.
scripts.outputs: Execution records, replay state, acceptance events.
scripts.effects: step can invoke a host; accept appends owner-supplied events; replay reads. Help/errors only in captures.
parser_declarations: accept_ap.add_argument('--asserts', help='JSON object of shared-key values; required when the task declares asserts')

scripts.inputs: Objective, executor, draft/adoption and owner/time.
scripts.outputs: Draft instance and adoption verification.
scripts.effects: draft defaults to host invocation; draft/adopt write files. Help/errors only.

scripts.inputs: Relay subcommand and data-dir.
scripts.outputs: Delegates to nexus_relay.cli.
scripts.effects: init/invite/serve/reconcile --apply write state; serve listens and may invoke containers/provider; help/errors only.

scripts.inputs: Blinded index, packs, sheets and optional trials.
scripts.outputs: Reviewer kit / collected judgments.
scripts.effects: Writes review directories or judgment JSON; no independent operator is authenticated by a label.

scripts.inputs: Instance, optional observations and --at.
scripts.outputs: Coverage and admissible target sets.
scripts.effects: Read-only; does not invoke selected targets.

scripts.inputs: Frozen pack, variant, policy, owner events and executor.
scripts.outputs: Trial run state/artifacts and trial rows.
scripts.effects: Default executor invokes host; fake writes synthetic fixtures; owner accept/resume modifies run state.
parser_declarations: sub.add_parser('brief', help='the owner decision brief for a nexus_instance run')

scripts.inputs: Agent, policy, output, model and probe options.
scripts.outputs: Host acceptance record / optional raw stream.
scripts.effects: Runs live Claude, installs temporary profile, writes probe files/records and restores installed profile; help/errors only.
parser_declarations: ap.add_argument('--expiry-wait', type=float, default=180, help='seconds the probe may wait for the policy window to close before reporting the expiry probe NOT_ATTEMPTED')
ap.add_argument('--keep-raw', action='store_true', help='also store the full stream-json transcript alongside the distilled one')
ap.add_argument('--policy', required=True, help='scope policy consumed by agent-capabilities.py')

scripts.inputs: Canonical divisions/tools registry and selector.
scripts.outputs: Keys / field values in canonical order.
scripts.effects: Read-only.
parser_declarations: sub.add_parser('tool-field', help='emit one field from one registered tool')
sub.add_parser('tools', help='emit tool keys in canonical order')

scripts.inputs: Agent/division/runbook selectors and optional list file.
scripts.outputs: Resolved adapter slugs or runbook list.
scripts.effects: Read-only.
